verification.note: CAUTION: no official copy is stored. The stored sources are the Nixon Peabody client alert of 20 July 2026 (archive/US-RI-01/2026-10-12/secondary.html), which confirms the Act's name, S 2195, signature by Governor McKee in June 2026, the 1 January 2027 effective date and the provisions in the summary, and the FastDemocracy tracker page for S 2195 (archive/_runs/2026-10-14-refresh-ids-ca-on-01-coe-01-int-15-us-ca/US-RI-01/extra-8f6f90705c/), which reproduces the Legislature's actions (Senate passage of Sub A as amended on 21 May 2026, House passage in concurrence on 8 June 2026, signed by the Governor on 22 June 2026). Both are secondary. The bill texts on webserver.rilegislature.gov and the General Assembly's press release could not be stored (connections refused), and no Governor or Attorney General page on the Act was found, so the effective date rests on the law-firm alert alone.

record.notes: Signed by the Governor on 22 Jun 2026 and effective 1 Jan 2027. The Senate passed Substitute A as amended on 21 May 2026 and the House passed it in concurrence on 8 Jun 2026; the House companion bill is H 7350. Enacted alongside two Rhode Island health-care AI laws of June 2026: S 2570 (notification when AI documents clinical visits) and S 2197 (Oversight of Artificial Intelligence Technology in Mental Health Care Act, barring AI from making independent therapeutic decisions), which are not recorded separately. Rhode Island was among roughly a dozen states that enacted companion-chatbot statutes in the first half of 2026.
